question: Should the supported cloud publish contract retain immutable snapshots containing private review text and require publisher credentials to also authorize reader-side post-cutover verification?
rationale: This intentionally changes data retention, authorization, and upgrade behavior; correctness tests cannot decide whether maintainers and operators accept that boundary.

options.title: Approve the coordinated boundary
options.body: Adopt the protocol with explicit dual-role credential migration, private-text scope, retention and deletion rules, deployment order, rollback guidance, and exact-head live proof.

options.title: Preserve the compatible default
options.body: Keep publisher-only publication as the default and make reader-verified immutable cutover an explicit strict mode until operators migrate.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Leave the draft unmerged if no owner accepts the cross-service authorization and private-data lifecycle.

recommendation.title: Approve the coordinated boundary
recommendation.body: Adopt the protocol with explicit dual-role credential migration, private-text scope, retention and deletion rules, deployment order, rollback guidance, and exact-head live proof.
